texts.about_this_item: A calcium bone with lean rabbit meat. A low-calorie treat for dogs that love to crunch without harming their figure. Made for adult dogs of medium and large breeds.
texts.ingredient_information: Rabbit meat, chicken meat, calcium bone, plant-derived by-products, minerals. Guaranteed analysis per 100 g: protein 23%, fat 4%, moisture 18%, fibre 3%, ash 7%; energy 284 kcal.
